name: io.github.cypher-osiris/lumi-verdict-mcp
title: Lumi Verdict: check an x402 seller before paying
description: One signed label before paying an x402 seller, from Lumi's test-buys on XRPL, Base and Stellar

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 0x private key of your Base wallet that pays in USDC (gasless, signed locally)

environmentVariables.name: XRPL_SEED
environmentVariables.description: Seed of your XRPL wallet that pays in XRP/RLUSD/USDC (signed locally)

environmentVariables.name: LUMI_PAY_ASSET
environmentVariables.description: BASE_USDC, XRP, RLUSD or USDC (XRPL). Default: XRP if XRPL_SEED set, else BASE_USDC

environmentVariables.name: LUMI_MAX_USD_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Per-call cap in USD for stablecoins (covers every Lumi endpoint)

environmentVariables.name: LUMI_SESSION_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Max total spend per server process
